name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop-builder
description: Self-contained Electron desktop packaging for DeepSeek Harness on macOS
author: DeepSeek AI

scripts.dist:dev: npm run test && npm run prepare:icon && npm run prepare:runtime && npm run prepare:profile && DSH_DESKTOP_CHANNEL=dev electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dir --arm64
scripts.dist:stable: npm run test && npm run prepare:icon && npm run prepare:runtime && npm run prepare:profile && DSH_DESKTOP_CHANNEL=stable electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dir --arm64
